BFGS's line search reaches the upper bound RCUT2B = 6 at eval 9, the best (1.031156e-01), and re-evaluates it at eval 10; the gradient there evaluates 5.999998 and 5.999996 (evals 11-12), and the stagnation window fires at eval 12: 12 + 3 + 3 = 18. With the lists before the fix (19), eval 10's re-evaluation came out at the rounding level below eval 9's (the ~1e-13 relative re-evaluation noise of the warm-started lattice relaxation), became the best and moved the window to eval 13 (13 + 3 + 3). RESTART RANDOM draws its restart points from std::random_device, so evals 13-18 differ from run to run; nothing pinned here depends on them: the best comes from the deterministic first launch (evals 1-12), and every restart stops after exactly 3 evals because no start in [4, 6] beats the incumbent at the upper bound (3 repeated runs on 2026-09-30 with exact neighbour lists: identical count, status, best loss and parameters).
